items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: See, Selma used to give me all my horns.

ctx.x: Yeah, because I was using a large-bore horn, you see. And I was popping. But he knew if I kept popping, it would wear me out. Take me out, see. So that's what he told me. He told me that. And I said, 'Pops, when that was gone, could I have it?' He says, 'Yes. That was yours.' See, Selma used to give me all my horns.
But you had heard him many times?
